caption: The drawing depicts a large, three-story rectangular building with a steeply sloped dark blue or black roof. The building has a red brick facade and features three rows of large, multi-paned windows with green window frames on each floor. There are a total of fifteen windows on the front face of the building, with five per row. The first floor also has two brown double doors, each situated beneath arched brickwork, one on the far left and one on the far right, with an additional set of three windows between them. The top floor is under the roof and contains three green-framed dormer windows, each with multiple panes, projecting from the roof. The background is a plain beige color, and there are no additional objects or figures present.
title: 168 John Street
